## Additional notices

### elkjs 0.12.0 — Eclipse Public License 2.0

<!-- licenses/addenda/elkjs.md -->

WingChunRoots ships **elkjs 0.12.0** (Eclipse Layout Kernel for JavaScript) unmodified to the
browser: the lineage explorer's Web Worker (`src/lib/lineage-layout/layout.worker.ts`) loads
`elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js`, and Node background jobs use the same file. The minified bundle
loses most licence comments, so this notice tells every recipient which licence applies and
where the source code is.

- **Package:** `elkjs` 0.12.0 from the npm registry,
  <https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs/v/0.12.0>
  (tarball <https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz>, integrity
  `sha512-YZcKynxVxYoKIOEpywEPwCFdg+BTbxQRNf3pbwdDCvc8O3kQD8bmIwSxKU1eOTVc4Xo+VG9Te+575mlfvOrhEQ==`).
- **Licence:** `EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later`. WingChunRoots receives and distributes elkjs
  under the **Eclipse Public License 2.0**; its full text follows below.
- **Copyright:** Kiel University and others; TypeFox and others (as stated in the file
  headers of elkjs).
- **Source code of the version used:**

### Noto Serif TC — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (brand mark glyph)

<!-- licenses/addenda/noto-serif-tc.md -->

The brand mark of WingChunRoots (a red seal with the character 根, "root") contains the
outline of one glyph, U+6839 根, traced from **Noto Serif TC Bold** as published in
`@fontsource/noto-serif-tc` 5.2.9 (file `noto-serif-tc-115-700-normal.woff2`). The outline is
embedded as an SVG path in `src/components/brand/brand-mark.tsx`, scaled and positioned; the
font itself is not shipped and is not a dependency.

- **Font:** Noto Serif TC, Copyright 2017 Adobe (<http://www.adobe.com/>), with Reserved Font
  Name "Source". Noto is a trademark of Google LLC.
- **Licence:** SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1, <https://openfontlicense.org/>.
- **Source:** <https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk> and
  <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/noto-serif-tc/v/5.2.9>.

The SIL Open Font License 1.1 allows fonts and their glyphs to be embedded in documents and
artwork; this notice and the licence text travel with the mark. The full licence text is the
one reproduced in this file for the self-hosted fonts (Gloock, Schibsted Grotesk, Noto Serif
Display), which are distributed under the same licence.

### sharp 0.35.5 and libvips (@img/sharp-libvips 1.3.4) — Apache-2.0 and LGPL-3.0-or-later

<!-- licenses/addenda/sharp.md -->

Next.js installs **sharp 0.35.5** as an optional dependency for server-side image
optimisation, together with the prebuilt binaries for the platform the server runs on:
`@img/sharp-<platform>` 0.35.5 and `@img/sharp-libvips-<platform>` **1.3.4** (libvips 8.18.7
and the libraries it links). They run only on the server and are never sent to the browser.
`pnpm licenses list --prod` leaves optional dependencies out, and which platform package is
installed depends on the machine, so they are named here once for every platform.

- **sharp and `@img/sharp-<platform>`:** Apache License 2.0, Copyright Lovell Fuller and
  contributors. Source: <https://github.com/lovell/sharp/tree/v0.35.5>. The Apache-2.0 text
  is listed under "Licence texts" with the other Apache-2.0 packages.
- **`@img/sharp-libvips-<platform>`:** GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later
  (libvips, glib, libheif, librsvg and others), with parts under BSD, MIT, MPL-1.1 and the
  other licences listed in the package's README. Source and build scripts:
  <https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/tree/v1.3.4>; libvips:
  <https://github.com/libvips/libvips>; licence text: <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt>.

The LGPL libraries are loaded as shared libraries, unmodified. You may replace them with
versions you build from the sources above.
